articles.summary: This month, we rebuilt the Infra Activity experience around a concise Terraform plan diff, so you can see exactly what changes on each resource without reading raw logs. We also brought cost reporting into every stack, environment, and block page, added the CLI pieces a CI pipeline needs to find and wait on a preview environment, and introduced Packaged Apps as a distinct kind of app. The catalog gained AlloyDB, Cloud KMS with customer-managed encryption for BigQuery, cross-account S3 access points, and scrubbed production Postgres snapshots. See more features and modules below.
articles.title: Changelog: September 2026
